new_rows_path.description: The cycle's fresh train slice (local path or resolved URI).
new_rows_path.title: New Rows Path

out_path.description: Where to write the mixed JSONL dataset.
out_path.title: Out Path

sources.description: Prior-cycle replay sources, OLDEST first. Each entry is a resolved dataset URI or a local path; a launch-resolved 'dataset:<name>@<v>' ref arrives here as 'uri#sha256=<hash>' and the fragment is stripped before reading (#1466).
sources.title: Sources

ratio.description: Replay share of the FINAL MIX — the denominator is the OUTPUT row count, not the new-row count. 0.2 means replay rows are ~20% of the rows written (new_rows * ratio/(1-ratio) replay rows). When the sources cannot fill the quota the op takes everything available and reports the true ratio_actual.
ratio.title: Ratio

strategy.description: How the replay quota is spread across `sources` — an OPEN enum (ADR-0095 Amendment 1 item 2). Implemented: 'uniform' (each source's share is proportional to its eligible row count, i.e. every prior row is equally likely) and 'recency_weighted' (share proportional to position+1, so LATER entries in `sources` — the more recent cycles — get more of the quota). RESERVED for v2, rejected with a clear error until #1626 lands the per-row/per-version eval history they need: 'hard_example' (rows the current model gets wrong) and 'forgetting_aware' (rows whose score degraded between adapter versions).
strategy.title: Strategy

seed.description: Seed for ALL sampling. Same inputs + same seed → byte-identical output, so the mix is reproducible from the receipt.
seed.title: Seed

dedup_against_new.description: Drop replay rows that exactly duplicate a new row (the pack's canonical row hash — the same notion of 'the same example' dataset/dedup uses).
dedup_against_new.title: Dedup Against New

normalize.description: Collapse whitespace before hashing for dedup_against_new (matches dataset/dedup).
normalize.title: Normalize

eval_report.description: RESERVED (ADR-0095 Amendment 1 item 2): the eval/forgetting (#1626) report the v2 'hard_example' / 'forgetting_aware' strategies will score candidate rows against. Accepted now so v2 is additive; ignored by the v1 strategies.
eval_report.title: Eval Report
